title.zh: 长期公共共同体运营：普通日常不断轨，季节计划可暂停、可复盘、可退役
title.en: Long-Term Civic Operations: Ordinary Life Stays Continuous while Seasonal Programmes Can Pause, Be Reviewed, and Retire

purpose.zh: 把问题季、开源季、城市 Beta 季和 Proof Week 嵌入全年普通使用、维护、投诉、退役和下一轮问题回流；以同一居民任务的昼间、夜间、故障和恢复连续旅程接入第 6 轮三载体回写。该合同整合既有机制，不重建维护、权利、资源、失败、气候、文化或任务经济合同。
purpose.en: Embed Problem Season, Open-source Season, City Beta Season and Proof Week within year-round ordinary use, maintenance, complaints, retirement and next-problem reflow. Connect the Round 6 three-carrier writeback through one resident task across day, night, failure and recovery. This contract integrates existing mechanisms rather than rebuilding maintenance, rights, resources, failure, climate, culture or mission-economy contracts.

backstage_frozen: Round 3 maintenance responsibility and ordinary-baseline restoration

authority_boundary.rule_zh: 概念日历只规定普通使用优先、季节计划的准入顺序和失败后的公开动作，不是排班表、活动确认、预算承诺或运营成绩。
authority_boundary.rule_en: The conceptual calendar defines ordinary-use priority, conditional programme sequence and public action after failure. It is not a roster, event confirmation, budget commitment or operating result.

annual_calendar.calendar_rule_zh: 全年默认是普通公共日；四季计划只有在责任、场地、权利、预算、维护、退出和批准逐项关闭后，才可在公告的限域窗口叠加。计划未激活、暂停或到期时，空间回到普通日常。
annual_calendar.calendar_rule_en: The default year is ordinary civic use. Each seasonal programme may overlay only within an announced bounded window after responsibility, site, rights, budget, maintenance, exit and authorization are separately closed. When inactive, paused or expired, the place returns to ordinary use.

public_services: staffed contact only when independently confirmed as online
paper or in-person complaint and correction route

conditional_programmes.entry_gate: community agenda rule + public problem + affected group + non-AI comparator + responsibility acceptance
conditional_programmes.exit: publish accepted, deferred and rejected agenda items with reasons; return unresolved items to ordinary service maintenance

conditional_programmes.entry_gate: source and licence review + minimum data + role separation + maintenance and retirement route
conditional_programmes.exit: freeze versions; publish missing evidence; do not proceed when rights, labour or exit responsibility stays open

conditional_programmes.entry_gate: all relevant G1 evidence and separately scoped authorization; ordinary path, staffed stop and place recovery demonstrably available
conditional_programmes.exit: stop, isolate, restore and write back; machine PASS never authorizes a public trial or deployment

conditional_programmes.ordinary_value: publish passes, failures, complaints, corrections, unresolved gaps and retirements in an understandable screen-free form
conditional_programmes.entry_gate: privacy-safe evidence + independent review scope + community agenda priority + no displacement of ordinary routes
conditional_programmes.exit: issue keep, correct, expand or retire recommendation; feed unanswered local problems into the next Problem Season

no_event_days.rule_zh: 无活动日不是空档，而是检验空间是否脱离节庆仍能支持通行、休憩、办事、学习、维护、投诉和安静停留。任何活动不得永久占用连续日常轨。
no_event_days.rule_en: A no-event day is not an empty slot. It tests whether the place supports passage, rest, ordinary service, learning, maintenance, complaints and quiet presence without a festival. No event may permanently occupy the continuous civic track.

time_covenant.interpretation: retained as an earlier G0 design rule only; not a confirmed opening time, legal noise limit, lighting value, staffed shift or operator commitment

protected_conditions: no event or validation claim may displace the continuous ordinary route
no screen, broadcast, sensor or account is required for the basic task
residents may decline participation, withdraw consent, leave or remain in ordinary use

quiet_screen_free_covenant.failure_rule: if any protected condition cannot be maintained, do not admit or stop the programme and restore ordinary use

role_types.duty: keep or safely refuse the same basic task through staffed/non-AI means and publish truthful online/offline/unknown state
receive oral, paper and in-person agenda items; publish acceptance, deferral and rejection reasons
receive incidents and complaints and trigger the declared stop path
exercise immediate physical or procedural stop authority
remove reversible components and document resource, interface, path and place restoration

review accessibility, consent, prohibited data, privacy-safe disclosure, screen-free parity and labour disclosure
independently retest the affected task and advise keep, correct, expand or retire

responsibilities.action: stop and switch to ordinary service

labour_disclosure.rule: paid duty, contracted service, community participation and voluntary labour are separate categories; voluntary labour is optional, disclosed, time-bounded, supported and never used to fill a statutory, safety, incident or continuous-service duty

three_carrier_operations_integration.transaction_rule: a calendar activation, staffed-state change, complaint hold, failure stop, recovery, correction, withdrawal or retirement is one append-only event; missing or conflicting carriers publish the most conservative state and prohibit proof restart

three_area_operations.night_or_quiet_rule: resident quiet and low-stimulation use overrides events; no invented community staffing
three_area_operations.failure_and_recovery: stop collection/matching, retain paper/manual service, withdraw screens/broadcast/temporary signs, restore the street and two courts
three_area_operations.cannot_copy: two-court consent/withdrawal sequence is community-specific and cannot be transplanted into equipment verification or commuting publication

three_area_operations.ordinary_priority: four-direction commuting, quiet rest and ordinary staffed service when independently confirmed
three_area_operations.conditional_use: evidence release or Proof Week display stays outside the continuous commuter route
three_area_operations.night_or_quiet_rule: commuting and screen-free information continue; event staging, screens and broadcast yield
three_area_operations.failure_and_recovery: publish correction and source status, retain prior version, clear the hall/platform overlay, restore commuter and service continuity
three_area_operations.cannot_copy: four-direction commuter continuity and public correction hall cannot be reduced to a verification court or resident co-learning courtyard

international_remote_retest_boundary.remote_role: repeat a bounded, privacy-safe evidence package; never replace local residents, local professional judgement, operator duty or statutory authorization
